
# Khetrakshak AI

> Khetrakshak AI (खेत रक्षक AI) is a bilingual agricultural web project focused on AI-assisted crop disease identification from leaf images, crop health information, crop-risk visualization, and farmer crop-care guidance.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://khetrakshak-ai.vercel.app/): Overview of the project and its features.
- [Crop disease detection](https://khetrakshak-ai.vercel.app/disease-detection): Upload a plant-leaf image to check for a possible disease classification.
- [Crop health](https://khetrakshak-ai.vercel.app/crop-health): Crop-health indicators and monitoring information.
- [Farmer advisory](https://khetrakshak-ai.vercel.app/farmer-advisory): General crop-care, irrigation, fertilizer, and disease-prevention guidance.
- [Crop risk map](https://khetrakshak-ai.vercel.app/risk-map): Demonstration visualization of crop-health risk zones.
- [Privacy policy](https://khetrakshak-ai.vercel.app/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://khetrakshak-ai.vercel.app/terms): Terms of use.

## Topics

- AI crop disease detection
- Crop disease detection from an image
- Upload a plant leaf photo to identify a possible disease

- फसल रोग की पहचान
- पौधे की फोटो से बीमारी पहचानें
- पत्ते की तस्वीर से रोग पहचानें
- फसल की बीमारी कैसे पहचानें
- फसल की देखभाल और रोगों से बचाव

## Languages

The website supports English and Hindi interface content.

## Important limitations

- Image-based results are potential classifications, not guaranteed diagnoses.
- Verify important crop-health decisions with qualified local agricultural experts and locally approved guidance.
- Some crop-health, advisory, and risk-map information may be illustrative or demonstration data rather than live field measurements.
- Do not assume that the site provides real-time weather, live regional disease surveillance, or treatment recommendations unless those capabilities are explicitly confirmed.
